'''Aeron''' is a respected [[Wise One]], who cannot channel. She is a [[Black Water]] [[Nakai]].

== Appearance ==
Aeron's hair is graying, her face is very tanned, just short of being leathery.

== Activities ==
She is one of the many Wise Ones who settle outside the city of [[Cairhien]] after the battle with the [[Shaido]] Aiel. Her apprentice is [[Estair]] and [[Egwene]] thinks that Aeron is pleasant and fairly easygoing for a Wise One.

Later, with [[Colinda]] and [[Edarra]], she is sent to the [[Royal Library of Cairhien]] by [[Sorilea]] to find out what the Aes Sedai delegation from the [[White Tower]] are looking for in there.

They find [[Nesune Bihara]] there, who is poking around looking for information on the [[seals]], which Wise Ones want as well. Nesune is startled by the great strength of Edarra and Colida and by the fact that Aeron can not channel at all but is equally considered and respected as a Wise One.

Aeron sends a couple of [[Maidens of the Spear]] to spy on the White Tower Aes Sedai on lady [[Arilyn]]'s palace, but they are caught, beaten and sent out, getting Aeron in trouble with the other Wise Ones.

She is one of the [[Wise Ones]] who are supervising the [[Aes Sedai]] held prisoner by the [[Aiel]] in [[Cairhien]] after [[Dumai's Wells]], and Aeron is quite hard on them, especially with [[Beldeine]].
